description: This file defines the EmploymentContractAPI class, a REST API endpoint for managing employee employment contracts within the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods for retrieving and updating employment contract data, handling file attachments, and validation rules.

classes.name: EmploymentContractAPI
classes.description: Defines API endpoints for retrieving and updating employee employment contracts, including handling contract attachment files and validation rules within the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Handles HTTP GET request to retrieve an employee's employment contract based on employee number.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Returns validation rules for the GET request to ensure the employee number provided is accessible.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Handles HTTP PUT request to update an employee's employment contract including start/end dates and contract attachments.

methods.name: updateEmploymentContract
methods.description: Updates or creates the employment contract details for the specified employee.

methods.name: updateContractAttachment
methods.description: Processes attachment file operations like adding, replacing, or deleting contract attachments.

methods.name: setAttachmentAttributes
methods.description: Sets file attributes on an EmployeeAttachment object from a Base64Attachment, including metadata and user info.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Returns validation rules for updating employment contract details, including date checks and attachment validations.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Method stub for deleting employment contracts (not implemented).

methods.name: getValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Method stub to get validation rules for delete operation (not implemented).
